description: This file defines a tool for managing nodes within a system, including actions like status, describe, pairing, notifications, media operations, and invocation. It includes schema validation, external dependencies, and a factory function to create the tool with configurable options.

methods.name: resolveApproveScopes
methods.description: Resolves approval scopes based on commands, returning relevant OperatorScope array.

methods.name: resolveNodePairApproveScopes
methods.description: Asynchronously resolves approval scopes for a node pairing request, querying gateway data.

methods.name: isPairingRequiredMessage
methods.description: Checks if a message indicates that pairing is required.

methods.name: extractPairingRequestId
methods.description: Extracts the request ID from a pairing message string.

methods.name: createNodesTool
methods.description: Factory function that creates a node management tool with configurable options, supporting various node actions.
